dod_gap.title: DoD gap KEO addresses

gaps.problem: Sensitive maintenance & military-adjacent text cannot freely hit commercial LLM APIs (FedRAMP/ITAR/FISMA).
gaps.keo: Operational answers on local Gemma/Phi/Mistral; GPT-4o only offline for KG/Q/judge; optional local embeddings.

gaps.gap: Gov API capacity vs mission tempo
gaps.problem: Army Enterprise LLM Workspace / Azure OpenAI Gov help but are limited relative to volume and classification needs.
gaps.keo: On-prem / air-gapped path with structured retrieval so smaller local models punch above weight.

gaps.gap: Wrong retrieval for the wrong job
gaps.problem: One RAG style fails: graphs help corpus sensemaking; chunks help procedural action.
gaps.keo: Dual benchmark + task router (sensemaking→KG, action→chunks, mixed→hybrid).

gaps.problem: Black-box answers are unacceptable for airworthiness / maintenance advice.
gaps.keo: Evidence cards with triple/chunk IDs and retrieval confidence for human verification.

gaps.problem: Frequency-weighted graphs bury low-count, high-severity relations.

why_others_should_use: Any org with regulated data (defense, aviation, energy, healthcare) that cannot ship prompts to public APIs.
Teams that need both dashboard-style sensemaking and step-level procedures from the same corpus.
Operators who need citation-like evidence, not just fluent text.
Researchers needing an OMIn-grounded aviation QA split that exposes the graph-vs-chunk tradeoff.

question_mix.implication: Benchmark is dual-use: ~63% sensemaking-like (analytical/contextual/global) vs ~37% actionable — a single retrieval policy cannot dominate both.

rarity_demo.takeaway: 4/5 high-severity edges and 51/60 safety-relevant edges fall outside the top 20% by frequency — frequency-only MST can under-prioritize rare but safety-critical relations.

headline_takeaways: gemma-3-27b-it: KEO beats text-chunk on sensemaking by 0.61 overall (mean over mined runs).
mistral-nemo-12b-it: KEO beats text-chunk on sensemaking by 0.48 overall (mean over mined runs).
phi-4-14b: KEO beats text-chunk on sensemaking by 0.41 overall (mean over mined runs).
gemma-3-it: oracle task routing scores 4.133 vs always-KEO 4.141 (-0.008) and always-chunk 4.015 (+0.119).
phi-4: oracle task routing scores 4.12 vs always-KEO 4.041 (+0.079) and always-chunk 4.002 (+0.119).
mistral-nemo-it: oracle task routing scores 3.814 vs always-KEO 3.799 (+0.015) and always-chunk 3.795 (+0.019).
4/5 high-severity edges and 51/60 safety-relevant edges fall outside the top 20% by frequency — frequency-only MST can under-prioritize rare but safety-critical relations.
